title: 根岸Sの後に・このままどこまで

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Haru Urara reflects on how much she enjoyed getting first place in the Negishi Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeing she's still as easygoing as ever, I try to put on the pressure by proposing she enters a higher-level race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The race is the G1 February Stakes… However, Haru Urara is unaffected after hearing the name and just starts talking about how cool it sounds.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I feel uneasy about Haru Urara's prospects if she stays so easygoing…
